entries: The verge dragon unleashes a massive amount of lightning aether, each creature in a 30 ft. radius sphere around it acting as a lightning rod. Each creature is targeted by a 10 ft. radius spherical burst of lightning. Each creature in an affected area must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) lightning damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. If a creature is affected by more than one heat lightning burst, it makes the saving throw once, taking cumulative damage from all effects at once.

action.name: Crackle Hiss {@recharge 5}
entries: The verge dragon unleashes a burst of static electricity in a 60 ft. cone. Each creature in the affected area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 39 ({@damage 7d10}) lightning damage and become {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. A paralyzed creature repeats its saving throw at the end of its turn and is no longer paralyzed on a success.

bonus.name: Erratic Blaster
entries: The verge dragon chooses a target it can see within 30 ft. of it. The creature must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, becoming {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute on a failure. A paralyzed creature repeats its saving throw at the end of its turn and is no longer paralyzed on a success.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The vouivre doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vouivre makes one Bite attack and one Whipcrack attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8+4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Whipcrack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8+4}) slashing damage. On a hit, the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage on a failure, and half as much on a success.

action.name: Lumisphere {@recharge 5}
entries: The vouivre gathers aether in its throat and tosses the sphere at a location it can see wtihin 80 ft. of it. The sphere explodes in a 20 ft. radius at the location. Each creature in the affected area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage on a failure, and half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the wyvern is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the creature instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Keen Senses
entries: The wyvern has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The wyvern can take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wyvern makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6+3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8+3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6+3}) piercing damage plus ({@damage 7d6}) poison damage. The target must succeed on {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Credit: Jotunn-Bane

monster.name: Magitek Deathclaw
languages: one language spoken by its creator

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Deathclaw makes two Death Grip attacks.

action.name: Death Grip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8+5}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition grappled} condition (escape {@dc 15}). The Magitek Deathclaw can only grapple one target at a time.
Credit: HomemadeMovies

monster.name: Magitek Reaper
languages: Understands one language spoken by its creator but can't speak it

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Reaper has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Reaper makes , and undefined.

action.name: Photon Stream
entries: The Magitek Reaper unleashes a hail of bullets in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Magitek Cannon
entries: The Magitek Reaper targets a point within 120 ft. of it that it can see. Each creature within 30 ft. of that point must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Force damage plus 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Overclock (2/Day)
entries: The Magitek Reaper takes the Dash or Disengage action.
Credit: HomemadeMovies

monster.name: Magitek Predator
languages: one language spoken by its creator

trait.name: Combat Ready
entries: The Predator has advantage on initiative rolls.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Predator has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Predator's weapons are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Predator makes three Magitek Claw attacks. When its Magitek Ray or Magitek Missile is available, it can use either in place of one Magitek Claw attack.

action.name: Magitek Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8+5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Magitek Ray {@recharge 5}
entries: The Magitek Predator's chassis unhinges and lets forth a concentrated beam of energy in a line 100 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Creatures in the line must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

action.name: Magitek Missiles {@recharge 5}
entries: The Magitek Predator chooses up to three target creatures. Each creature must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
Credit: HomemadeMovies

monster.name: Magitek Vanguard
languages: one language spoken by its creator

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The Magitek Vanguard deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Magitek Vanguard has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Vanguard makes three Cermet Drill attacks.

action.name: Cermet Drill
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10+5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Drill Cannons {@recharge 5}
entries: The Magitek Vanguard empowers its drills and unleashes a blast in a line 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not knocked prone.
Credit: HomemadeMovies

trait.name: Reckoning (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When Garuda is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead she regains 285 hit points, summons {@creature Suparna|MmansWriteOfSorenMM} and {@creature Chirada|MmansWriteOfSorenMM} at locations she can see within 40 ft. of her and summons a Storm of Reckoning. The Storm of Reckoning is described on the next page. Additionally, Garuda now benefits from her own Malicious Aura.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: Garuda doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when she flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Garuda's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Malicious Aura
entries: Garuda's allies within 30 ft. of her deal +5 thunder damage on all of their attacks.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Garuda fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Garuda makes three Wicked Talon attacks.

action.name: Wicked Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10+5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Friction
entries: Garuda unleashes a violent burst of wind at a location she can see within 60 ft. of her in a 15 ft. radius sphere. Each creature in the affected area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage on a failure and half as much on a success.

action.name: Wicked Wheel
entries: Garuda spins wildly releasing a forceful kick in a 15 ft. radius around her. Each creature in the affected area must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 3d8}) thunder damage and be knocked back 15 ft. on a failure, and half as much damage and not be knocked back on a success.

action.name: Slipstream (Recharge 3-4)
entries: Garuda unleashes a downburst in a 15 ft. cone in front of her. All creatures in the affected area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) thunder damage and become {@condition stunned} until the end of their next turn on a failure, or take half as much damage and not be stunned on a success.

action.name: Aerial Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: Garuda unleashes a massive torrent of howling winds in a 20 ft. radius, 40 ft. high cylinder centered at a location she can see within 60 ft of her. All creatures in the affected area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) thunder damage on a failure, or take half as much damage and not be {@condition stunned} on a successful one. The area is then battered by howling winds for 1 minute, becoming difficult terrain. A creature that enters the space for the first time or begins their turn inside must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage on a failure and half as much on a success.

action.name: Summon Egis (1/Day)
entries: Garuda summons one {@creature Suparna|MmansWriteOfSorenMM} and one {@creature Chirada|MmansWriteOfSorenMM} at a location she can see within 40 ft. of her.

bonus.name: Feather Rain
entries: Garuda rains feathers in a 10 ft. radius circle around her. Each creature in the affected area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. Garuda then may move up to 30 ft. of her fly speed.

legendary.name: Swipe
entries: Garuda makes a Wicked Talon attack.

legendary.name: Soar
entries: Garuda flies up to 30 ft..

legendary.name: Feather Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Garuda uses Feather Rain.

mythic.name: Vengeful Talon
entries: Garuda makes a Wicked Talon attack, which deals an additional 5 thunder damage.

mythic.name: Feather Hell
entries: Garuda uses Feather Rain.

mythic.name: Torturous Wheels (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Garuda uses Wicked Wheel or orders Suparna to use Wicked Wheel.

variant.name: Storm of Reckoning
entries: Garuda's storm of reckoning is a 300 ft. radius, 500 ft. tall cylinder of raging dark winds that shred all in its vicinity. At its center you'll find her newly formed battle field, the eye of the storm which features a highly powerful updraft in a 40 ft. radius, 500 ft. tall cylinder which grants all creatures without a flying speed a 30 ft. fly speed while inside the eye of the storm.

A creature that enters the raging winds of the storm or begins its turn in the area must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) thunder damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage and be forcibly moved. If it is in the air, it is dragged 60 ft. towards the ground, and if it is already on the ground, it is dragged 60 ft. towards the eye of the storm in a straight line. It takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 ft. of movement made in this way, if it hits the ground or an object. The storm is considered difficult terrain. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and is not forcibly moved. The raging winds are considered difficult terrain if you are moving away from the eye of the storm.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: Chirada doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when she flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Soothing Winds
entries: At the start of Chirada's turn, all of Chirada's allies within 30 ft. of her recover 13 ({@dice 3d6+3}) hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Chirada makes two Talon attacks.

action.name: Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8+5}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: Suparna doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when she flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Malicious Aura
entries: Suparna's allies within 30 ft. of her deal +4 thunder damage on all of their attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Suparna makes two and Talon attacks.

action.name: Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10+5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Friction
entries: Suparna unleashes a violent burst of wind at a location she can see within 60 ft. of her in a 10 ft. radius sphere. Each creature in the affected area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) thunder damage on a failure and half as much on a success.

action.name: Wicked Wheel
entries: Suparna spins wildly, releasing a forceful kick in a 10 ft. radius around her. Each creature in the affected area must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage on a failure and be knocked back 10 ft. on a failure, and half as much damage and not be knocked back on a success.

trait.name: Crimson Cyclone (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Ifrit, Lord of the Inferno would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 287 (23d10+161) hit points. Additionally, Ifrit, Lord of the Inferno can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 25,000 XP (50,000 XP total) for defeating Ifrit, Lord of the Inferno after this trait activates.

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever Ifrit is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Magic Nature
entries: Ifrit's attacks count as magical and Ifrit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Searing Aura
entries: At the start of each of Ifrit's turns, each creature within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Ifrit fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ifrit, Lord of the Inferno uses the Frightful Presence action one time followed by two Claw attacks and one Tail attack.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Ifrit's choice that is within 120 ft. of it and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Ifrit's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10+8}) slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8+8}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Incinerate {@recharge 5}
entries: Ifrit exhales a breath of fiery force in a 30 ft. cone. Each creature must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking ({@damage 8d8}) fire damage on a failure or half as much on success.

bonus.name: Infernal Surge
entries: Ifrit moves up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see. This movement doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity.

bonus.name: Eruption (3/Day)
entries: The ground beneath the feet of each creature within 60 ft. of Ifrit explodes. Each creature must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 10d8} fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

mythic.name: Inferno Howl (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Ifrit summons an Infernal Nail at a unoccupied space on the ground within 30 ft. and begins channeling aether into it. The Nail has the following stats, AC: 12, HP: 100, Immune to fire, and psychic damage, Resistant to non magical bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage. Until the nail is either destroyed or explodes on the following round, Ifrit takes no actions as he begins to charge up aether. On initiative count "0" on the following round, the Nail explodes in a 60 ft. radius. Each creature other than Ifrit becomes vulnerable to fire damage and Ifrit's Hellfire damage is increased by ({@damage 5d6}) fire damage.

mythic.name: Hellfire (1/Day) (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Ifrit summons a torrent of hellfire. Each creature within a 60 ft. radius of Ifrit must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking ({@damage 15d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Can only be used after using Infernal Howl.
Credit: Jotunn-Bane

trait.name: Call of the Depths (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Leviathan, Lord of the Whorl would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 277 (15d20+120) hit points and he summons a {@creature Wavespine Sahagin|MmansWriteOfSorenMM} and a {@creature Wavetooth Sahagin|MmansWriteOfSorenMM} on locations within 60 ft. of him. Additionally, Leviathan, Lord of the Whorl can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 25.000 XP (50.000 XP total) for defeating Leviathan, Lord of the Whorl after this trait activates.

trait.name: Agile Swimmer
entries: While Leviathan is underwater, his movement is unaffected by difficult terrain.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Leviathan can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Corrupted Water
entries: All water in a 200 ft. radius around Leviathan is corrupted, a creature can only hold its breath for half as much time and gains twice the amount of exhaustion when suffocating when in the corrupted water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Leviathan fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Leviathan, Lord of the Whorl makes two Bite attacks and one Tail attack. He can replace one Bite attack with a Scale Darts attack or forgo both of his Bite attacks to use Water Spout instead.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8+6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12}, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10+6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Scale Darts
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10}, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10+4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Water Spout
entries: Leviathan conjures a bubble of corrupted water on a point he can see within 60 ft. of him. Creatures within a 10 ft. radius centered of that point must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

action.name: Body Slam {@recharge 5}
entries: Leviathan slams his body, each creature in a 40 ft. long and 20 ft. wide line originating from him must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 7d10}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 20 ft. away from the line on a failure or half as much and not be pushed on a success. Leviathan then moves without provoking oportunity attacks to a point within that line. If Leviathan finishes his move in a creature's space, that creature is harmlessly moved away to the closest unoccupied space.

action.name: Call Followers (1/Day)
entries: Leviathan, Lord of the Whorl summons a {@creature Wavespine Sahagin|MmansWriteOfSorenMM} and a {@creature Wavetooth Sahagin|MmansWriteOfSorenMM} within 60 ft. of him in unoccupied spaces. They have their own initiative and are Leviathan's allies.

action.name: Tidal Wave (Only With Mythic Trait Active) (1/Day)
entries: Leviathan conjures a massive 60 ft. wide and 20 ft. tall wave of corrupted water on a point it can see within 120 ft. of him. The wave moves 100 ft. in a straight line, each creature in the wave's path must make a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw, taking 20 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and 55 ({@damage 10d10}) acid damage and be pushed to the end of the wave's movement on a failure, or half as much and not be pushed on a success.

legendary.name: Scale Darts
entries: Leviathan, Lord of the Whorl makes a Scale Darts attack.

legendary.name: Summon Wave Spume (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Leviathan summons a {@creature Wave Spume|MmansWriteOfSorenMM} in a location within 60 ft. of him. The spume acts as an ally  and has its own initiative count.

legendary.name: Water Spout (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Leviathan, Lord of the Whorl uses the Water Spout action.

mythic.name: Briny Darts
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10}, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10+5}) piercing damage. On a hit, the target must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be wounded with corrupted water on a failure. While wounded this way, the creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) acid damage at the end of each of its turns, it can also repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

mythic.name: Spiral Dive (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Leviathan moves up to his swimming speed in a straight line without provoking oportunity attacks, he can use this swimming speed in place of a walking or flying speed for this movement. Each creature in Leviathan's path must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed to an unoccupied space at the end of Leviathan's path on a failure, or half as much and not be moved on a success. If Leviathan ends his movement in a creature's space, that creature is harmlessly moved away to the closest unoccupied space.
Credit: Yamil

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The wave spume can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the wave spume dies, it bursts in acid, each creature within 10 ft. of the wave spume must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity Saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage on a failure and half as much on a success.

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The wave spume can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 in. wide without squeezing.

action.name: Acid Bubble
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4}, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6+2}) acid damage. On a hit, the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or receive an additional 9 ({@damage 2d6+2}) acid damage at the end of its next turn.
Credit: Yamil

trait.name: To Those Who Are Worthy (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Odin, the Dark Divinity would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 262 (25d12+100) hit points. Additionally, Odin, the Dark Divinity can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

trait.name: Tension
entries: The sky darkens where Odin treads. Odin is surrounded by an aura of non-magical darkness that extends in a 300 ft. radius. This darkness spreads around corners.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Odin fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Odin, the Dark Divinity makes three Zantetsuken attacks or makes three Gungnir Lance attacks.

action.name: Zantetsuken
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10+8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Gungnir Lance
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 14}, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8+8}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Hall of Fear
entries: Odin shouts a warcry befitting of a Primal targeting three creatures it can see within 40 ft. of it. The targets must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Odin's Hall of Fear for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Hall of Lead {@recharge 5}
entries: Odin strikes the ground beneath it, up to 3 creatures in a 20 ft. radius sphere centered on Odin must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. A target has their speed set to 0 ft. on their next turn on a failed save.

bonus.name: Hall of Sorrow (3/Day)
entries: Odin radiates an immense pressure targeting one creature it can see within 30 ft. of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or gain disadvantage on all attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Stride
entries: Odin can move a distance up to his movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks and can move through entities. Every entity Odin passes through takes {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Zantetsuken (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Odin, the Dark Divinity makes a Zantetsuken attack.

legendary.name: Gungnir Lance (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Odin, the Dark Divinity makes a Gungnir Lance attack.

mythic.name: Einherjar (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Odin carves a horrifying sigil into the sky, causing a spectral barrage of blades to consign those around it to death. Each creature within 120 ft. of Odin must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 1d10 + 8}) force damage and becomes marked for 1 minute on a failed save, or half as much damage and not being marked on a successful one.

mythic.name: Shin-Zantetsuken (1/Day)
entries: Odin releases a flurry of slashes with Zantetsuken. Each creature marked by Einherjar within 120 ft. of Odin must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 85 ({@damage 9d10+36}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Credit: JPLDN

trait.name: Retrial (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When Ramuh is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead he regains 312 hit points and summons 6 grey arbiters at locations he can see within 60 ft. of him. One of the grey arbiters acts on initiative count 20, 17, 14, 10, 5, 1.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Ramuh fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ramuh makes two attacks using ether his Adjudicator's Gavel or Spark Strike attacks in any combination.

action.name: Adjudicator's Gavel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10+4}) bludgeoning damage plus 33 ({@damage 6d10}) lightning damage.

action.name: Shock Strike
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11}, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8+5}) lightning damage. Hit or miss, the bolt explodes and the target and each creature within a 10 ft. radius sphere around the target must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) lightning damage on a failure, and half as much on a success.

action.name: Chaotic Thunderstorm {@recharge 5}
entries: Ramuh chooses a creature within 60 ft. of him that he can see. That creature must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw, on a failure that creature is {@condition charmed} by Ramuh for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature takes no actions and cannot move.

If the creature is charmed at the start of Ramuh's next turn, as a bonus action, he may unleash a furious lightning bolt which drops the creature to 0 hit points and cause the creature to start making death saving throws.

All other hostile creatures a 120 ft. radius sphere around Ramuh become lightning rods. Each creature must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking #d12 lightning damage on a failure, or half as much on a successful one where # is equal to the number of verdicts Ramuh received.

trait.name: Diamond Dust (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When Shiva is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious, instead she regains 253 hit points, becomes resistant to fire damage, and moves up to 100 ft. without triggering opportunity attacks. trait.name: Magic Armoury
entries: Shiva can use her power over ice to create and destroy her weaponry at will. There are some actions that can only be taken while Shiva wields a specific arm; Shiva can only possess one at a time and must dismiss one before summoning another. While wielding these weapons, Shiva's weapon attacks are magical.

entries.name: Gentlemanly Pose
entries: Senor Sabotender strikes a pose most gentlemanly. Any humanoid within 300 ft. of Senor Sabotender that can see him must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until Senor Sabotender stops posing. Senor Sabotender must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to maintain the pose. It can stop posing at any time. The pose ends if Senor Sabotender is incapacitated. While charmed by Senor Sabotender, a target is incapacitated. If the charmed target is more than 5 ft. away from Senor Sabotender, they must move on its turn toward Senor Sabotender by the most direct route. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than Senor Sabotender, a target can repeat the saving throw. A creature can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it. entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10+3}) piercing damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) acid damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the worm can't use its Bite attack on another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by the worm. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10+3}) piercing damage. The creature is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

The worm can have only one creature swallowed at a time. While the worm isn't incapacitated, it can regurgitate the creature at any time (no action required) in a space within 5 ft. of it. The creature exits {@condition prone}. If the worm dies, it likewise regurgitates a swallowed creature.

action.name: Sand Breath (1/Day)
entries: The worm unleashes a makeshift sandstorm from its mouth, pushing sand out of its body with force in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the affected area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) bludgeoning damage and becoming {@condition blinded} on a failure, or half as much and not becoming blinded on a success. A blinded creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending its blindness on a success.
The worm may use Sand Breath once per day. Use of Sand Breath is recovered after it uses Bottomless Desert.

action.name: Earth Break {@recharge 5}
entries: If the worm uses at least 10 ft. of movement to emerge from the ground, it can do so with extra power causing damage on its arrival. Each creature within 10 ft. of the worm must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 4d12}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed back 10 ft. on a failure, or half as much damage and is not pushed back on a success. If the creature would be in the same space as the worm, it is harmlessly moved to an adjacent space.

bonus.name: Bottomless Desert {@recharge 5}
entries: While underground at the start of its turn, the worm can rapidly draw sand into its body in a 15 ft. radius circle around its location. Each creature in the affected area must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 ft. close to the worm on a failure, and not be moved on a successful one.

entries.name: Echoes of the Dead
entries: The succubus is a voidsent which has forced its dark soul into the body of a humanoid woman. They are reported to possess a trancendant grace and an otherworldly beauty which allows the to easily lure unwitting adventurers to their dooms.

The voidsent gains more than just their physical form from their host. They also gain some of the memories of their host body and possibly their personality traits and habits. A DM can roll on this table to determine what quirk a succubus possesses:

rows: It is obsessed with fixing, preening, brushing, or otherwise touching its hair.
It craves the favourite food of its host, seeking it out and devouring it despite not needing food to sustain itself.
It bites its nails whenever its mind wanders.
It has an irrational fear of spiders and avoids them when it can.
It is overly apologetic, saying sorry even while killing its victims.
It has a love of clothes and enjoys dressing its corpse body in many different outfits.
It loves stories of famous adventurers, constantly comparing itself to well known heroes of Eorzea.
It inherited the nervousness of its host, often tapping its feet or fingers on nearby surfaces.

legendaryGroup.name: Shiva
lairActions: On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Shiva takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; Shiva can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

items: Shiva creates an opaque wall of ice on a solid surface she can see within 120 ft. of she. The wall can be up to 30 ft. long, 30 ft. high, and 1 ft. thick. When the wall appears, each target within its area is pushed 5 ft. out of the wall's space, appearing on whichever side of the wall it wants. Each 10-ft. section of the wall has AC 5, 30 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The wall disappears when Shiva uses this lair action again or when the Shiva dies.

A blisteringly cold wind blows through the lair near Shiva. Each target within 120 ft. of Shiva must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage. Gases and vapors are dispersed by the wind, and unprotected flames are extinguished. Protected flames, such as lanterns, have a 50 percent chance of being extinguished.
Until the beginning of the next round, Shiva can move through walls, doors, ceilings, and floors as if they weren't there.
